windows.sin_instalacion: No previous installation was found. Run instalar.cmd from the complete package.
windows.parado: Application stopped. Your test data is preserved. Reopen Expedientes ETF from the desktop or Start menu, or run instalar.cmd.
windows.actualizado: Update complete. Test data and accounts have been preserved.
windows.borrar_pregunta: ALL data and accounts in this demonstration will be deleted. Other applications are unaffected. Type BORRAR and press Enter to proceed, or just press Enter to cancel
windows.cancelado: Operation cancelled. Your data is preserved.
windows.motor_local: This test can only use the local PC engine. Close the window and ask IT to remove the configured remote connection.
windows.acceso_descripcion: Open Expedientes ETF in its own window.
windows.accesos_listos: Shortcuts created on the desktop and in the Start menu. You can reopen the application from them after stopping it.
windows.acceso_ocupado: A shortcut with this name belongs to another installation. Keep it and ask IT for help.
windows.navegador: Microsoft Edge and Google Chrome were not found. Install either browser and reopen the application.
windows.abrir_error: The application could not restart. Open the container application, start its machine and run instalar.cmd to see the help message.
windows.desinstalar_pregunta: All data and shortcuts for this demonstration will be deleted. Type DESINSTALAR and press Enter to proceed, or just press Enter to cancel
windows.desinstalado: Demonstration uninstalled. Its data and shortcuts have been removed. Unrelated files are preserved and the container application is still installed.
windows.directorio_ajeno: Choose a new folder for this demonstration. The selected folder contains another application’s files or links to another location.
